decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits close to the core seasonal range and was featured prominently on the home page, so keeping it costs little and its value is still plausible.
The one-tier pyramid is a core-adjacent product made with existing workshop skills, so its carrying cost is low and its option value remains.

The electronic music box with interchangeable discs is distant from the core, but it got home-page visibility and carries a platform logic, so it is worth keeping while demand for new discs is tested.
The motif platform got a second edition in 2019, which signals positive resolution, but it is a peripheral electronic line with uncertain staying power.
The Christmas motif platform is a cheap seasonal add-on to the music box system, but it is distant from the core, so dropping it is nearly as likely as keeping it if the platform underperforms.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established craft offer and was featured on the home page, so the firm is likely to keep it in the range.
